paper_title: First search for axion dark matter with a Madmax prototype
notes: First axion DM search with MADMAX dielectric haloscope prototype (CB200) in Morpurgo magnet at CERN. Two mass ranges: 76.56-76.82 ueV and 79.31-79.53 ueV. Best limit |g_agamma| ~2e-11 GeV^-1. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 4 exclusion curves; the limit reaches ~2e-11 at peak sensitivity (~76.74 ueV and ~79.45 ueV) and rises toward the edges of each band. Precise per-bin values (0.9 kHz bins) available in the Zenodo dataset. | selector: text (sole candidate)
